summary: Iter134 — Training Center + Fire Ext Bulk Import. Backend: 17/17 pytest cases passing on /app/backend/tests/test_iter134_training_center.py covering Training Center portals/list/single/PDF/admin-gates/CRUD and Fire-Ext Bulk Import template/preview/commit/history/auth-gates. Frontend: /ops-training renders 16 tiles + 9 portal filters + working search ('bulk import' narrows to 1); single guide page /ops-training/safety-fire-ext-bulk-import renders full sections with callouts; PDF API returns valid 16.7KB application/pdf bytes with %PDF magic header. Found one real backend bug: training_center._seed_if_empty() is not idempotent on guide-list expansion.

minor.issue: _seed_if_empty() only seeds when collection is completely empty. When DEFAULT_GUIDES is expanded post-deploy (e.g., the new safety-fire-ext-bulk-import guide added this iter), the new defaults are NEVER seeded automatically. Production was sitting at 15 guides (missing the bulk-import guide) until I manually called POST /seed?reset=true with admin token. The user-facing PDF download and the link from SafetyFireExtImport will 404 in any environment that was seeded before iter134.

Pydantic body validation appears to run before/in-parallel-with the require_admin dependency in FastAPI — anonymous POST with an invalid body (e.g., slug pattern mismatch) returns 422 instead of 401. Minor — anonymous POST with a valid body correctly returns 401. Not a security issue.

issues: Missing data-testid attributes on guide tiles, portal filter buttons, PDF download button, and search input. Tests had to fall back to text/href selectors. Recommend adding data-testid="ops-training-tile-<slug>", data-testid="ops-training-portal-<key>", data-testid="ops-training-search", data-testid="ops-guide-pdf-btn" for stable future automation.

action_items: FIX (BACKEND): Make /api/training-center _seed_if_empty() idempotent on guide-list expansion. Suggested: iterate DEFAULT_GUIDES and upsert any default slug that is missing from the collection (still preserving any admin-edited content). Alternative: hash DEFAULT_GUIDES slug-set and reseed when hash changes. As-is, every new default guide added in code requires manual POST /api/training-center/seed?reset=true by an admin to surface, which the user/QA can easily miss.

ADD (FRONTEND): data-testid attributes on /ops-training tiles, portal filter chips, search input, and the PDF download button on /ops-training/:slug — improves test stability and aligns with the rest of the platform's conventions.

rca of the issue: ROOT CAUSE — training_center.py defines DEFAULT_GUIDES (currently 16 entries). build_training_center_router calls _seed_if_empty() which only inserts when count_documents({}) == 0. The first deploy seeded 15 guides; the safety-fire-ext-bulk-import guide was added to DEFAULT_GUIDES afterward, but the seeder never re-fires because the collection is no longer empty. As a result, /api/training-center/guide/safety-fire-ext-bulk-import returns 404, /api/training-center/guide/safety-fire-ext-bulk-import/pdf returns 404, and /ops-training/safety-fire-ext-bulk-import shows 'Guide not found'. Mitigation: rewrite _seed_if_empty to: 1) load all default slugs, 2) query existing slugs, 3) insert (or upsert) the diff. Preserve is_default=True flag and admin-edited overrides. After fix, no admin reset call should be required for new defaults to appear.
